items.text: Long ago. <break time="0.8s" /> The Leopard lived. <break time="0.8s" /> In a place called the High Veldt. <break time="0.8s" /> The High Veldt was hot, dry, and full of sand. <break time="0.8s" /> The grass was sandy brown. <break time="0.8s" /> And the rocks were sandy brown, too. <break time="0.8s" /> The Giraffe, the Zebra. <break time="0.8s" /> And the other animals. <break time="0.8s" /> Lived there, too. <break time="0.8s" /> They were all sandy brown. <break time="0.8s" /> Just like the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Leopard was the sandiest and brownest. <break time="0.8s" /> Of them all. <break time="0.8s" /> He went hunting. <break time="0.8s" /> With a hunter. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had a bow and arrows. <break time="0.8s" /> The Leopard hid. <break time="0.8s" /> In the sandy grass. <break time="0.8s" /> And waited quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> Nobody could see him. <break time="0.8s" /> So he was very good at hunting. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon the animals were too scared. <break time="0.8s" /> To stay on the High Veldt. <break time="0.8s" /> So the Giraffe led them all away. <break time="0.8s" /> To a great forest.

오래전에. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범은 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하이벨트라고 불리는 곳에. <break time="0.8s" /> 하이벨트는 덥고, 메마르고, 모래로 가득했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 풀은 모래빛 갈색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 바위들도 모래빛 갈색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기린과 얼룩말과. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 다른 동물들도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그곳에 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 모두 모래빛 갈색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 꼭 풀처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 표범은 가장 모래빛이고 가장 갈색이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들 모두 중에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 사냥을 다녔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 사냥꾼과 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 사냥꾼은 활과 화살을 가지고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범은 숨었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모래빛 풀숲에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 조용히 기다렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아무도 그를 볼 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 사냥을 아주 잘했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 동물들은 너무 무서웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하이벨트에 머물기에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 기린이 그들 모두를 이끌고 떠났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 숲으로.

The forest was full of trees, bushes, and shadows. <break time="0.8s" /> Stripy shadows, spotty shadows. <break time="0.8s" /> And patchy shadows. <break time="0.8s" /> Were everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> The sun was shining. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the leaves. <break time="0.8s" /> In little pieces. <break time="0.8s" /> The animals lived there. <break time="0.8s" /> For a long, long time. <break time="0.8s" /> Slowly they began to change color. <break time="0.8s" /> The Giraffe got big blotches. <break time="0.8s" /> And the Zebra got stripes. <break time="0.8s" /> Other animals became darker. <break time="0.8s" /> Like the bark of the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> Now they were much harder to see. <break time="0.8s" /> Than before. <break time="0.8s" /> Meanwhile the Leopard and the hunter. <break time="0.8s" /> Were still on the High Veldt. <break time="0.8s" /> They looked everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> But there was nothing to eat. <break time="0.8s" /> They ate rats and beetles. <break time="0.8s" /> And they both got stomachaches.

숲은 나무와 덤불과 그림자로 가득했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 줄무늬 그림자, 점박이 그림자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 얼룩덜룩한 그림자가. <break time="0.8s" /> 어디에나 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 해가 비치고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나뭇잎 사이로. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 조각조각으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 동물들은 그곳에서 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 오랫동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 천천히 그들은 색이 변하기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기린에게는 커다란 얼룩이 생겼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 얼룩말에게는 줄무늬가 생겼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다른 동물들은 더 어두워졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무껍질처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 이제 그들은 훨씬 더 보기 어려웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 전보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그동안 표범과 사냥꾼은. <break time="0.8s" /> 여전히 하이벨트에 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 사방을 찾아보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 먹을 것이 아무것도 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 쥐와 딱정벌레를 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 둘 다 배탈이 났다.

One day. <break time="0.8s" /> They met Baviaan. <break time="0.8s" /> The wise old baboon. <break time="0.8s" /> He was the wisest animal. <break time="0.8s" /> In all of South Africa. <break time="0.8s" /> Where did all the animals go. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked the Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> Baviaan winked and said. <break time="0.8s" /> They went into other spots. <break time="0.8s" /> My advice to you, Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> Is to go into other spots. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as you can. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the hunter asked. <break time="0.8s" /> And what about me. <break time="0.8s" /> You should change, too. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as you can said Baviaan. <break time="0.8s" /> They did not understand. <break time="0.8s" /> But they went to look for the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> After many days. <break time="0.8s" /> They saw a great, tall forest. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the tree trunks were covered. <break time="0.8s" /> With spots and stripes of shadow. <break time="0.8s" /> It is dark here. <break time="0.8s" /> But full of little pieces of light. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Leopard.

어느 날. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 바비안을 만났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 지혜로운 늙은 개코원숭이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 가장 지혜로운 동물이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 남아프리카 전체에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 동물들이 다 어디로 갔지. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바비안은 눈을 찡긋하며 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 다른 곳으로 갔지. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범아, 너에게 주는 내 충고는. <break time="0.8s" /> 다른 곳으로 가라는 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 되도록 빨리. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 사냥꾼이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그럼 나는 어떻게 하지. <break time="0.8s" /> 너도 바뀌어야 해. <break time="0.8s" /> 되도록 빨리 바비안이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 알아듣지 못했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 숲을 찾으러 떠났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 여러 날이 지난 뒤. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 크고 높은 숲을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안에서는 나무줄기들이 덮여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그림자의 점과 줄무늬로. <break time="0.8s" /> 여긴 어둡다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 작은 빛 조각들로 가득하다. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범이 말했다.

The Leopard and the hunter. <break time="0.8s" /> Could smell the animals. <break time="0.8s" /> They could hear them, too. <break time="0.8s" /> But they could not see them. <break time="0.8s" /> They hunted all day long. <break time="0.8s" /> But they caught nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> When it got dark. <break time="0.8s" /> The Leopard heard. <break time="0.8s" /> Something breathing nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> He jumped on it. <break time="0.8s" /> And held it until morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The hunter caught something. <break time="0.8s" /> That smelled like a Giraffe. <break time="0.8s" /> In the morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The Leopard looked at his Zebra. <break time="0.8s" /> In surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> It smells like a Zebra. <break time="0.8s" /> But it has black stripes. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> We are not on the High Veldt now. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Zebra. <break time="0.8s" /> They let the two animals go. <break time="0.8s" /> And they walked into the shadows. <break time="0.8s" /> One, two, three. <break time="0.8s" /> Where is your breakfast now. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Zebra.

표범과 사냥꾼은. <break time="0.8s" /> 동물들의 냄새를 맡을 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 소리도 들을 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그들을 볼 수는 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 하루 종일 사냥했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 아무것도 잡지 못했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어두워지자. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범은 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가까이에서 무언가 숨 쉬는 소리를. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 그것에게 달려들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아침까지 붙잡고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사냥꾼은 무언가를 잡았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기린 냄새가 나는. <break time="0.8s" /> 아침이 되자. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범은 자기 얼룩말을 바라보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀라서. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼룩말 냄새가 나는데. <break time="0.8s" /> 검은 줄무늬가 있잖아. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리는 이제 하이벨트에 있지 않아. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼룩말이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 두 동물을 놓아주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 두 동물은 그림자 속으로 걸어 들어갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하나, 둘, 셋. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 아침밥은 이제 어디 있지. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼룩말이 말했다.

That is a good trick. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the hunter. <break time="0.8s" /> I want to learn it, too. <break time="0.8s" /> So he made himself dark. <break time="0.8s" /> Like the shadows under the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> But what about me. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked the Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> Baviaan meant. <break time="0.8s" /> Spots on your coat. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the hunter. <break time="0.8s" /> I do not want. <break time="0.8s" /> To look like the Zebra. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Leopard. <break time="0.8s" /> I will take spots. <break time="0.8s" /> But please do not make them too big. <break time="0.8s" /> The hunter put. <break time="0.8s" /> His five fingers close together. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he pressed them. <break time="0.8s" /> All over the Leopards sandy coat. <break time="0.8s" /> Everywhere they touched. <break time="0.8s" /> They left five little black marks. <break time="0.8s" /> Now the Leopard could hide anywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> And the two lived happily. <break time="0.8s" /> They never changed again. <break time="0.8s" /> Because they were happy. <break time="0.8s" /> Just as they were.

그거 좋은 꾀로군. <break time="0.8s" /> 사냥꾼이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나도 그걸 배우고 싶어. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 자기 몸을 어둡게 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 아래 그림자처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런데 나는 어떡하지. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 바비안은 말한 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 털가죽의 점을. <break time="0.8s" /> 사냥꾼이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 원하지 않아. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼룩말처럼 보이는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 점으로 할게. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 너무 크게는 만들지 말아 줘. <break time="0.8s" /> 사냥꾼은 모았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다섯 손가락을 바짝 붙여. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그는 손가락을 눌렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 표범의 모래빛 털가죽 곳곳에. <break time="0.8s" /> 손가락이 닿은 곳마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작고 검은 자국 다섯 개가 남았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이제 표범은 어디에든 숨을 수 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 둘은 행복하게 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 다시는 바뀌지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 행복했기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 지금 그대로가.
